name: Vanna Bardot
summary: Vanna Bardot is an American pornographic film actress. She has won multiple awards within her career, including the 2023 XBIZ Award for Female Performer of the Year, the 2024 AVN Award for Female Performer of the Year, and the 2024 XBIZ and XRCO Female Performer of the Year awards.
